name: Barrio Star
notes: 4 photos: 1 and 3 are drink-only menus (margaritas/cocktails/wine/beer/soft drinks), skipped. 2 and 4 are the same food menu photographed on two visits with minor price/item updates (2 lacks shrimp cocktail, tres leches cake, and prices nachos $12 vs $10); merged, preferring the more complete/later version (4) on conflicts.
